post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Cash-relative sleeve value was common, but no candidate covered the opportunity cost of displacing 10 percent of the active core; the best formal EV and PnL deltas remained negative.

prediction.confidence_reason: Ten of eleven prior additive overlays had positive aggregate EV and all eleven had positive PnL, but those tests added and double-scaled exposure and the 31 representatives were historically selected; fixed capital conservation and complete-panel trial adjustment may erase the apparent edge, so success odds are deliberately low.

production_impact: None. Gate 4-P is evaluation-only and fail-closed; champion Gate 4, live/default orders, paper orders, core ranking, sizing, exits, and risk budgets are unchanged.
rejection_reason: All 31 candidates had negative formal aggregate EV and PnL deltas versus 100% core. The best candidate was -0.94934 EV and -$19,348.24 PnL, materially regressed in two windows, worsened ES95 by 5.71%, and had a -2.49485 simultaneous 90% EV lower bound.
